title: Panel
description: Fiori panel: expandable (animated) or fixed, header text or custom header.

usage.summary: Group information within a page in a section that can collapse to save space.
useWhen: Let users reveal or hide related information within the current page.
Keep a section title and its content together without implying navigation to another destination.
Use fixed for always-visible content; use collapsed and onToggle when the application controls disclosure.

avoidWhen.when: Provide a focused content preview with navigation or a task action.
